description: Creates a new incorporation request draft bound to the verified email, using any fields provided. Requires a verificationToken from verify_email_otp; every other field is optional. Returns a draftId that identifies the draft for later updates, submission, and status checks.

alternativeCompanyNames.description: Fallback company names in priority order

shareAmount.description: Number of shares allocated to this founder

jurisdiction.description: Target jurisdiction, e.g. "BVI", "CAYMAN", "PANAMA" — free text is accepted

notes.description: Anything else relevant: existing structures, PEP status, special requests

urgency.description: Timeline constraints, e.g. "needed before token launch July 1"

verificationToken.description: Token from verify_email_otp — the draft is bound to this email

name: create_incorporation_draft
title: Create incorporation draft
